understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid, modify the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation to match each goal cell’s requirements, then step onto every goal to complete each level and ultimately win all levels.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is performed one direction per turn, with walls blocking movement. Shape modifiers cycle the piece’s shape, color modifiers cycle its color, and rotation modifiers rotate it 90° clockwise. A goal activates only when shape, color, and rotation all match. Movement consumes stamina, including blocked attempts; reaching zero stamina costs a life and resets stamina. Losing all lives ends the game.
